articles.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
articles.summary: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

articles.title: Bayern draw with Cologne as Kane picks up ankle injury
articles.summary: England captain Harry Kane will be out "for the next few months" after undergoing surgery on torn ankle ligaments sustained during Bayern Munich's 1-1 Bundesliga draw with Cologne on Friday.
